shortDescription: Module for setup of AnalyticsProfile Avi RESTful Object

options.name: apdex_response_threshold
options.description: If a client receives an http response in less than the satisfactory latency threshold, the request is considered satisfied. It is considered tolerated if it is not satisfied and less than tolerated latency factor multiplied by the satisfactory latency threshold. Greater than this number and the clients request is considered frustrated. Allowed values are 1-30000. Unit is milliseconds. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed val

options.name: apdex_response_tolerated_factor
options.description: Client tolerated response latency factor. Client must receive a response within this factor times the satisfactory threshold (apdex_response_threshold) to be considered tolerated. Allowed values are 1-1000. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 4), basic (allowed values- 4) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: apdex_rtt_threshold
options.description: Satisfactory client to avi round trip time(rtt). Allowed values are 1-2000. Unit is milliseconds. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 250), basic (allowed values- 250) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 250.

options.name: apdex_rtt_tolerated_factor
options.description: Tolerated client to avi round trip time(rtt) factor. It is a multiple of apdex_rtt_tolerated_factor. Allowed values are 1-1000. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 4), basic (allowed values- 4) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: apdex_rum_threshold
options.description: If a client is able to load a page in less than the satisfactory latency threshold, the pageload is considered satisfied. It is considered tolerated if it is greater than satisfied but less than the tolerated latency multiplied by satisifed latency. Greater than this number and the clients request is considered frustrated. A pageload includes the time for dns lookup, download of all http objects, and page render time. Allowed values are 1-30000. Unit is milliseconds. Allowed with any value in en

options.name: apdex_rum_tolerated_factor
options.description: Virtual service threshold factor for tolerated page load time (plt) as multiple of apdex_rum_threshold. Allowed values are 1-1000. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 4), basic (allowed values- 4) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: apdex_server_response_threshold
options.description: A server http response is considered satisfied if latency is less than the satisfactory latency threshold. The response is considered tolerated when it is greater than satisfied but less than the tolerated latency factor * s_latency. Greater than this number and the server response is considered frustrated. Allowed values are 1-30000. Unit is milliseconds. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 400), basic (allowed val

options.name: apdex_server_response_tolerated_factor
options.description: Server tolerated response latency factor. Servermust response within this factor times the satisfactory threshold (apdex_server_response_threshold) to be considered tolerated. Allowed values are 1-1000. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 4), basic (allowed values- 4) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: apdex_server_rtt_threshold
options.description: Satisfactory client to avi round trip time(rtt). Allowed values are 1-2000. Unit is milliseconds. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 125), basic (allowed values- 125) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 125.

options.name: apdex_server_rtt_tolerated_factor
options.description: Tolerated client to avi round trip time(rtt) factor. It is a multiple of apdex_rtt_tolerated_factor. Allowed values are 1-1000. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 4), basic (allowed values- 4) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.0.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: client_log_config
options.description: Configure which logs are sent to the avi controller from ses and how they are processed. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: client_log_streaming_config
options.description: Configure to stream logs to an external server. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: conn_lossy_ooo_threshold
options.description: A connection between client and avi is considered lossy when more than this percentage of out of order packets are received. Allowed values are 1-100. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 50), basic (allowed values- 50) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 50.

options.name: conn_lossy_timeo_rexmt_threshold
options.description: A connection between client and avi is considered lossy when more than this percentage of packets are retransmitted due to timeout. Allowed values are 1-100. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 20), basic (allowed values- 20) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: conn_lossy_total_rexmt_threshold
options.description: A connection between client and avi is considered lossy when more than this percentage of packets are retransmitted. Allowed values are 1-100. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 50), basic (allowed values- 50) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 50.

options.name: conn_lossy_zero_win_size_event_threshold
options.displayName: Conn Lossy Zero Win Size Event Threshold
options.description: A client connection is considered lossy when percentage of times a packet could not be trasmitted due to tcp zero window is above this threshold. Allowed values are 0-100. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 2), basic (allowed values- 2) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.

options.name: conn_server_lossy_ooo_threshold
options.description: A connection between avi and server is considered lossy when more than this percentage of out of order packets are received. Allowed values are 1-100. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 50), basic (allowed values- 50) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 50.

options.name: conn_server_lossy_timeo_rexmt_threshold
options.displayName: Conn Server Lossy Timeo Rexmt Threshold
options.description: A connection between avi and server is considered lossy when more than this percentage of packets are retransmitted due to timeout. Allowed values are 1-100. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 20), basic (allowed values- 20) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: conn_server_lossy_total_rexmt_threshold
options.displayName: Conn Server Lossy Total Rexmt Threshold
options.description: A connection between avi and server is considered lossy when more than this percentage of packets are retransmitted. Allowed values are 1-100. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 50), basic (allowed values- 50) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 50.

options.name: conn_server_lossy_zero_win_size_event_threshold
options.displayName: Conn Server Lossy Zero Win Size Event Threshold
options.description: A server connection is considered lossy when percentage of times a packet could not be trasmitted due to tcp zero window is above this threshold. Allowed values are 0-100. Unit is percent. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 2), basic (allowed values- 2) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enable_adaptive_config
options.description: Enable adaptive configuration for optimizing resource usage. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: enable_advanced_analytics
options.description: Enables advanced analytics features like anomaly detection. If set to false, anomaly computation (and associated rules/events) for vs, pool and server metrics will be deactivated. However, setting it to false reduces cpu and memory requirements for analytics subsystem. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.5, 18.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Special default for e

options.name: enable_ondemand_metrics
options.description: Virtual service (vs) metrics are processed only when there is live data traffic on the vs. In case, vs is idle for a period of time as specified by ondemand_metrics_idle_timeout then metrics processing is suspended for that vs. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: enable_se_analytics
options.description: Enable node (service engine) level analytics forvs metrics. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: enable_server_analytics
options.description: Enables analytics on backend servers. This may be desired in container environment when there are large number of ephemeral servers. Additionally, no healthscore of servers is computed when server analytics is enabled. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: enable_vs_analytics
options.description: Enable virtualservice (frontend) analytics. This flag enables metrics and healthscore for virtualservice. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: exclude_client_close_before_request_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Client Close Before Request As Error
options.description: Exclude client closed connection before an http request could be completed from being classified as an error. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_conn_drop_client_small_window_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Conn Drop Client Small Window As Error
options.description: Exclude connection dropped by vs due to client advertises a very small window size from the errors. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- true), basic (allowed values- true) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: exclude_dns_policy_drop_as_significant
options.displayName: Exclude Dns Policy Drop As Significant
options.description: Exclude dns policy drops from the list of errors. Field introduced in 17.2.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_gs_down_as_error
options.description: Exclude queries to gslb services that are operationally down from the list of errors. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_http_error_codes
options.description: List of http status codes to be excluded from being classified as an error. Error connections or responses impacts health score, are included as significant logs, and may be classified as part of a dos attack. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: exclude_invalid_dns_domain_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Invalid Dns Domain As Error
options.description: Exclude dns queries to domains outside the domains configured in the dns application profile from the list of errors. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_invalid_dns_query_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Invalid Dns Query As Error
options.description: Exclude invalid dns queries from the list of errors. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_issuer_revoked_ocsp_responses_as_error

options.description: Exclude the issuer-revoked ocsp responses from the list of errors. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- true), basic (allowed values- true) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: exclude_no_dns_record_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude No Dns Record As Error

Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_no_valid_gs_member_as_error

Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_persistence_change_as_error
options.description: Exclude persistence server changed while load balancing from the list of errors. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_revoked_ocsp_responses_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Revoked Ocsp Responses As Error
options.description: Exclude the revoked ocsp certificate status responses from the list of errors. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- true), basic (allowed values- true) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: exclude_server_dns_error_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Server Dns Error As Error
options.description: Exclude server dns error response from the list of errors. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_server_tcp_reset_as_error
options.displayName: Exclude Server Tcp Reset As Error
options.description: Exclude server tcp reset from errors. It is common for applications like ms exchange. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_sip_error_codes
options.description: List of sip status codes to be excluded from being classified as an error. Field introduced in 17.2.13, 18.1.5, 18.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: exclude_stale_ocsp_responses_as_error

options.name: exclude_syn_retransmit_as_error

options.name: exclude_tcp_reset_as_error

Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: exclude_unavailable_ocsp_responses_as_error

options.name: exclude_unsupported_dns_query_as_error

Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 0), basic (allowed values- 0) edition. Special default for essentials edition is 0, basic edition is 0, enterprise edition is 20. Default value when not s

Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 1209600), basic (allowed values- 1209600) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1209600.

Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 10), basic (allowed values- 10) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10.

Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 25.

options.name: hs_max_security_penalty

Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- 100), basic (allowed values- 100) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 100.

options.name: hs_min_dos_rate

options.name: hs_performance_boost
